paras_en: Global financial markets have recently been roiled again, with US equities continuing to fall and financial conditions tightening sharply, creating a danger reminiscent of late 2018. With expectations of further Fed rate hikes remaining high, investors are deeply concerned that monetary tightening could further exacerbate market turbulence.

2018 panic: forced liquidation and tightening gloom

US stocks have recently faced severe selling pressure, with the S&P 500 closing lower for six consecutive trading days and slipping below its 200‑day moving average. Intraday the index even swung from a gain of more than 1% to a plunge of about 2% in a volatile reversal. All 11 industry sectors were hit, including traditionally defensive utilities and consumer staples, which also fell hard.

Regarding this sharp sell‑off, Goldman Sachs trading head Rich Privorotsky noted in a new report that the current market pressure is not a typical sector rotation but a “full‑blown liquidation.” Privorotsky warned that the market is moving from a decline in risk appetite to a deeper phase of liquidity contraction.
At the same time, Goldman Sachs’ US Financial Conditions Index (FCI) rose to 124.48, a one‑year high, indicating that financial conditions are tightening at an unusually rapid pace.

Late‑2018 rate hikes forced the Fed to “turn around”

The present market situation mirrors the fourth quarter of 2018. In 2018 the Fed raised rates four times and in December lifted the federal‑funds target range to 2.25%‑2.50%. Subsequently the S&P 500 fell from its September peak to a low on Dec. 24, a cumulative drop of 19.8%, edging toward a technical bear market.

Historical experience shows that sustained market pressure eventually forces a policy pivot. On Jan. 30, 2019 the Fed publicly said it would “remain patient” when adjusting rates, signalling a clear pause in hikes, and US stocks promptly rallied.

Privorotsky analysis points out that the market now faces a dual threat of tightening financial conditions and pressured economic growth, deepening the conflict between policy stance and market reality.

Gold loses its safe‑haven status, revealing a liquidity crisis

Fed officials have recently been issuing hawkish messages, heightening market fear. Fed Governor Christopher Waller publicly mentioned the possibility of a 50‑basis‑point (½‑point) rate hike, and meeting minutes showed continued support for further tightening, which not only raises capital costs but also sharply dents expected returns on AI infrastructure investments.

More noteworthy is the abnormal cross‑asset linkage. Gold, usually a hedge asset, this time fell in lockstep with equities, slipping below $3,600 per ounce, while copper plunged about 5% in a single day.

Privorotsky emphasized that gold is the best gauge of the depth of the current liquidity crisis; simultaneous selling of stocks and gold means investors are not merely reallocating assets but are cashing out, reflecting a contraction of liquidity across the financial system.
ANZ added that speculative long positions in gold still have roughly 200 tons of potential reduction, suggesting that de‑leveraging pressure may not yet be fully exhausted.

When will a policy catalyst appear?

Despite the gloom, Privorotsky believes the scale of the current one‑sided de‑leveraging indicates US equities may be near a tactical bottom. With institutional positions already under‑weighted, any positive catalyst could trigger a sharp rebound. Strategically, Privorotsky continues to favor “long short‑term Treasury bonds,” arguing that the bond market is beginning to price in the Fed’s policy missteps.

However, a true trend reversal still depends on a clear shift in policy expectations. Goldman Sachs economists still forecast a 25‑basis‑point (¼‑point) Fed hike in December and another in March 2027, a view that diverges markedly from bond‑market pricing.

Privorotsky judges that while the market is watching the PCE price index and the non‑farm payroll report closely, the data point most likely to force the Fed to reassess its policy path will be the upcoming November CPI consumer price index.

items.title: 美股慘崩 AI產業是泡沫破裂還是價格重估？
items.title_en: U.S. Stocks Plummet: Is the AI Industry Facing a Bubble Burst or a Price Re‑valuation?
paras: 近期美國股市遭遇強烈賣壓，先前引領華爾街牛市的人工智慧(AI)概念股顯著拉回，帶動主要股指陷入技術性修正區間。市場對科技巨頭龐大資本支出能否轉化為實際商業回報的疑慮逐漸升溫，加上總經利率政策與企業管理層變動等因素，引發投資人對 AI 投資熱潮永續性的廣泛討論。

科技股賣壓席捲華爾街

那斯達克指數本周重挫 10%，創下 2020 年 3 月以來最劇烈的單周跌幅，自 10 月 6 日創下的歷史高點 27,599.79 點累計回撤約 18%，回吐 2026 年以來全部漲幅。
根據 CNN 統計數據，那斯達克指數自高點以來蒸發市值約 8.7 兆美元。同時，標普 500 指數連續七個交易日下跌，創下 2020 年 2 月以來最長連跌紀錄，與道瓊工業平均指數雙雙自高點回撤逾 10%，正式進入技術性修正區間。反映市場恐慌情緒的 VIX 指數則升至 35.89，達近 19 個月高點。
半導體與雲端基礎設施類股同樣承壓。費城半導體指數單日暴跌 10.7%，iShares 半導體 ETF(SOXX-US)單周下跌 17.4%，自歷史高點累計回撤約 43%。新興 AI 雲端服務供應商 CoreWeave 股價跌至 39.51 美元，低於其上市發行價；AMD 與 Alphabet 單周分別下跌 20.5% 與 10.3%，顯示市場賣壓已擴及整個 AI 供應鏈。

輝達高層異動與 Anthropic 上市考驗

市場關注焦點之一為半導體龍頭輝達(NVDA-US)的劇烈波動。輝達單周股價重挫約 23%，創 2008 年 10 月以來最大單周跌幅，自 10 月高點回撤 47.5%，市值蒸發約 2.7 兆美元。輝達近期面臨前執行長黃仁勳離職及美國證券交易委員會(SEC)會計處理調查等管理層與合規疑慮。儘管輝達最新季度財報優於市場預期並給出強勁展望，仍未能阻止股價下跌。
另一方面，AI 初創企業 Anthropic(ANT-US) 完成估值 810 億美元的首次公開發行(IPO)，每股定價 83 美元。雖然掛牌首日上漲 17%，但隨後股價拉回至 88.91 美元，吐出大部分首日漲幅。市場原先期待 Anthropic 的上市能為科技股注入強心針，但此一效應未能持續。

升息預期與債務融資風險

科技股承壓的背景還包含宏觀經濟與政策環境的轉變。美國聯準會於 9 月進行升息，且市場預期 12 月可能持續調升利率，提高了資料中心建設與基礎設施擴充的融資成本。政治層面上，美國國會期中選舉後，立法機關針對 AI 資料中心建設與相關法規提出更嚴格的審查主張。
歐洲央行(ECB)11 月報告估計，美國主要科技巨頭至 2030 年在 AI 基礎設施上的累計資本支出可能達到 5.5 兆美元，且對債務融資的依賴度持續上升。分析指出，輝達對 CoreWeave 等 AI 開發商與雲端業者的投資及融資關係，形成了緊密的產業生態系，當部分企業面臨資金或獲利壓力時，可能產生連鎖反應。

估值重估與泡沫疑慮之辯

對此輪下跌意義，市場看法高度分歧。Acadian Asset Management 投資組合經理Owen Lamont評估美國股市處於泡沫狀態的機率達 70%，指出高估值、投機熱潮、新股發行與資金湧入等四大警訊皆已顯現。
Haverford Trust 投資策略主管Hank Smith認為，當前 AI 熱潮背後有 Meta、蘋果與輝達等具備實質獲利之龍頭企業支持，非空想泡沫；但市場需要時間修復，AI 類股可能在未來一段時間內暫時失寵。
摩根大通資產管理首席策略師David Kelly表示，認為美股在經歷大幅上漲後出現技術性修正屬正常現象，將當前波動形容為「輕微感冒」，未必代表嚴重系統性危機。
LPL Financial 首席固定收益策略師Lawrence Gillum指出，當前拉回「並非泡沫破裂」，AI 投資週期仍有持續運作的空間。
Treasury Partners 首席投資長Richard Saperstein分析，將此輪下挫歸因於「AI 價格重估」，主因為資料中心建設放緩與融資環境收緊。
Jones Trading 策略師Mike O'Rourke強調，輝達與黃仁勳被視為 AI 基礎建設熱潮的象徵，當市場對其透明度與可信度產生疑慮時，整體市場信心必然受到衝擊。
paras_en: Recent U.S. equity markets have been hit by strong selling pressure, pulling back the AI‑related stocks that previously led Wall Street’s bull market and pushing major indices into a technical correction zone. Concerns are rising that the massive capital expenditures of tech giants may not translate into real commercial returns, and together with macro‑policy interest‑rate moves and changes in corporate leadership, investors are broadly debating the sustainability of the AI investment frenzy.

Tech‑stock selling pressure sweeps Wall Street. The Nasdaq fell about 10% this week, marking its steepest single‑week decline since March 2020, and has retreated roughly 18% from its October 6 all‑time high of 27,599.79 points, erasing all gains made since 2026.

According to CNN data, the Nasdaq has shed about $8.7 trillion in market value since its peak. At the same time, the S&P 500 has fallen for seven consecutive trading days, the longest losing streak since February 2020, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average has also pulled back more than 10% from its highs, officially entering a technical correction zone. The VIX, reflecting market fear, rose to 35.89, a near‑19‑month high.

Semiconductor and cloud‑infrastructure stocks are also under pressure. The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index plunged 10.7% in a single day, and the iShares Semiconductor ETF (SOXX‑US) fell 17.4% over the week, representing about a 43% decline from its historic peak. Emerging AI cloud provider CoreWeave slid to $39.51, below its IPO price; AMD and Alphabet fell 20.5% and 10.3% respectively over the week, showing that the sell‑off has spread across the entire AI supply chain.

Nvidia’s leadership shake‑up and Anthropic’s IPO test the market. One focal point is the dramatic volatility of semiconductor leader Nvidia (NVDA‑US), whose stock dropped roughly 23% for the week – the biggest weekly decline since October 2008 – retreating 47.5% from its October high and wiping out about $2.7 trillion in market value. Nvidia recently faced the departure of former CEO Jensen Huang and an SEC accounting‑practice investigation, raising governance and compliance concerns. Even though Nvidia’s latest quarterly results beat expectations and offered a strong outlook, the stock kept falling.

On the other hand, AI startup Anthropic (ANT‑US) completed an IPO valuing it at $81 billion, pricing shares at $83 each. Although the stock jumped 17% on debut, it quickly fell back to $88.91, giving back most of its first‑day gains. The market had initially hoped Anthropic’s listing would inject fresh vigor into tech stocks, but that effect proved short‑lived.

Rising‑rate expectations and debt‑financing risks. The backdrop to the tech‑stock pressure also includes macro‑economic and policy shifts. The Federal Reserve raised rates in September and markets anticipate further hikes in December, increasing financing costs for data‑center construction and infrastructure expansion. Politically, after the U.S. mid‑term elections, Congress is proposing stricter scrutiny of AI data‑center projects and related regulations.

The European Central Bank’s November report estimates that U.S. tech giants could spend up to $5.5 trillion on AI infrastructure through 2030, with growing reliance on debt financing. Analysts note that Nvidia’s investments and financing ties with AI developers such as CoreWeave and cloud providers create a tightly knit ecosystem, so financial or profitability pressures on some firms could trigger a chain reaction.

Valuation re‑assessment and bubble‑risk debate. Opinions diverge sharply on the meaning of this sell‑off. Acadian Asset Management portfolio manager Owen Lamont estimates a 70% probability that the U.S. market is in a bubble, citing four warning signs: lofty valuations, speculative hype, new‑issue sprees and massive capital inflows.

Haverford Trust’s investment‑strategy head Hank Smith argues that the current AI boom is backed by profit‑generating leaders like Meta, Apple and Nvidia, not a fanciful bubble, but the market needs time to heal and AI stocks may remain out of favor for a while.

JPMorgan Asset Management chief strategist David Kelly says that a technical correction after a sharp rally is normal, describing the current volatility as a “slight cold” that does not necessarily signal a serious systemic crisis.
LPL Financial chief fixed‑income strategist Lawrence Gillum notes that the pull‑back “is not a bubble burst” and that the AI investment cycle still has room to operate.

Treasury Partners chief investment officer Richard Saperstein attributes the recent dip to an “AI price re‑valuation,” driven mainly by a slowdown in data‑center construction and tighter financing conditions.

Jones Trading strategist Mike O'Rourke emphasizes that Nvidia and Jensen Huang are seen as symbols of the AI infrastructure boom; when doubts arise about their transparency and credibility, overall market confidence is inevitably shaken.

items.title: 美股恐慌指數VIX飆升至40 市場究竟在擔心什麼？
items.title_en: US Stock Panic Index VIX Spikes to 40 – What Is the Market Really Worried About?
paras: 華爾街周五(20日)遭逢慘烈拋售，被譽為「恐慌指數」的芝加哥選擇權交易所波動率指數(VIX)一度暴升至 40 關卡，收在 35.89，單日大漲逾 26%，創下自 2025 年 4 月關稅動盪以來的最高紀錄。
《Barron’s》報導指出，這通常意味著兩件事：投資人不再相信人工智慧預測的數據，而且，儘管難以置信，拋售潮可能即將結束。
受到 AI 科技股拋售潮蔓延影響，標普 500 指數重挫 3.70%、那斯達克指數大跌 5.28%，道瓊指數重挫 1.93%，三大指數均已陷入技術性修正區間。
其中，晶片巨頭輝達(NVDA-US)因執行長黃仁勳離職風波及監管機構調查會計問題的報導，單日暴跌約 14%、單周重挫 23%。人工智慧新星 Anthropic (ANT-US)掛牌第二日同樣下挫近 10%。
晨星(Morningstar)分析師 Michael Field 認為，Anthropic 上市所帶來的解脫感「已經徹底結束」；盛寶銀行(Saxo)分析師 Charu Chanana 指出，市場「不再僅僅尋求 AI 需求的證明」。
負責編製這一指標的 Cboe 全球市場公司，其衍生性商品市場情報主管 Mandy Xu 指出，VIX 的上漲更多是因應標普 500 指數下跌 3.6% 所產生的「機械性反應」，而非市場因極度恐慌而瘋狂搶購避險工具所致。她表示：「短期內的不確定性確實大增，但不代表恐懼情緒也隨之大幅升高。」
她解釋，指數上漲有超過八成屬於標普 500 大跌產生的連鎖反應與機械式定價調整，而非市場急於購買下行保護的恐慌性搶購。
雖然 VIX 升至 30 點以上確實反映了市場壓力，但這類情況通常一年會發生數次，且持續時間往往不超過幾天。
同時，歷史數據顯示，VIX 觸及 40 通常是潛在買進訊號。歷史上當 VIX 達到 40 後，標普 500 指數在隨後 6 個月內多半能反彈約 20%。
儘管如此，仍有一些投資人押注波動率將會持續下去。Thompson Capital Management 管理合夥人 Matthew Thompson 仍表示：「VIX 出現大幅右尾走勢的條件可能已經成熟。」
paras_en: Wall Street suffered a brutal sell‑off on Friday (the 20th), with the Chicago Board Options Exchange’s volatility index (VIX), known as the “fear gauge,” briefly soaring to the 40 level and closing at 35.89, up more than 26% in a single day – the highest jump since the tariff turmoil of April 2025.
Barron’s reported that this usually signals two things: investors no longer trust AI‑generated forecasts, and, unbelievably, the selling frenzy may be nearing its end.

The AI tech‑stock sell‑off spread to the broader market, dragging the S&P 500 down 3.70%, the Nasdaq off 5.28% and the Dow Jones down 1.93%, with all three major indices now in technical correction territory.

Chip giant Nvidia (NVDA‑US) plunged about 14% in one day and 23% over the week after reports of CEO Jensen Huang’s departure and a regulator’s probe into accounting issues, while AI newcomer Anthropic (ANT‑US) fell nearly 10% on its second trading day.

Morningstar analyst Michael Field said the relief brought by Anthropic’s IPO “has completely vanished”; Saxo analyst Charu Chanana added that the market “is no longer just looking for proof of AI demand.”

Mandy Xu, head of market intelligence for derivatives at Cboe Global Markets, which compiles the VIX, said the index’s rise was largely a “mechanical reaction” to the S&P 500’s 3.6% drop rather than a panic‑driven rush for safe‑haven assets. She noted, “Short‑term uncertainty has indeed surged, but that doesn’t mean fear sentiment has risen proportionally.”
She explained that over 80% of the VIX’s increase stemmed from the chain reaction and formulaic pricing adjustments triggered by the S&P 500’s plunge, not from frantic buying of downside protection.
While a VIX above 30 does reflect market pressure, such spikes typically occur several times a year and usually last only a few days.
Historical data show that a VIX reaching 40 often serves as a buying signal; historically, after the VIX hits 40, the S&P 500 has tended to rebound roughly 20% within the following six months.

Nevertheless, some investors still bet that volatility will persist. Matthew Thompson, managing partner at Thompson Capital Management, said, “The conditions for a pronounced right‑tail move in the VIX may already be in place.”

items.title: CTA陷「愈跌愈賣」惡性循環！高盛：未來一周美股將出現另一波大規模拋售
items.title_en: CTA Caught in a 'Sell More as Prices Fall' Vicious Cycle! Goldman Sachs: Another Massive Sell‑off Expected in U.S. Stocks Next Week
paras: 美股近期賣壓持續擴大，高盛警告，市場正面臨「賣壓引發更多賣壓」的惡性循環，系統性投資人仍有大規模減碼需求尚未釋出，未來一周恐進一步加重股市壓力。
根據《彭博》周六（21日）報導，高盛交易員周五（20日）發布研究報告指出，該行衡量市場情緒的「恐慌指數」已升至滿分10分中的9分，顯示系統性投資人的賣壓正在全面擴散。
高盛模型估算，即使市場未進一步下跌，趨勢追蹤基金未來一周仍可能賣出數百億美元股票；若行情持續走弱，潛在賣壓將進一步擴大。
本輪跌勢已重創科技股。那斯達克100指數周五單日下跌5.6%，創2020年3月以來最大單周跌幅；費城半導體指數重挫11%，輝達(NVDA-US) 則較10月6日高點累計下跌近50%。
賣壓也開始蔓延至散戶偏好的個股及加密貨幣相關資產，顯示市場避險情緒已不再侷限於機構投資人的持股，而是逐漸擴散至更廣泛的風險資產。
此外，市場原本期待Anthropic(ANT-US) 上市能為風險資產帶來新的投資動能，但相關期待未能實現。另一方面，投資人對AI基礎設施龐大資本支出能否產生足夠回報的疑慮持續升高，也壓抑科技股估值，市場目前仍缺乏明確的止跌訊號。

CTA未來一周恐再賣出806億美元股票

高盛估算，以商品交易顧問（CTA）為代表的趨勢追蹤策略，過去一個月已經賣出570億美元股票，目前美股淨部位更已轉為淨空頭190億美元。
不過，機構減碼可能還沒有結束。根據高盛模型，未來一周若市場維持平盤，CTA仍可能賣出658億美元股票；若股市進一步下跌，潛在賣出規模將擴大至806億美元；即使市場反彈，也可能觸發286億美元賣盤。
CTA等趨勢追蹤策略會根據市場價格走勢及波動程度，自動調整投資部位。當股市下跌時，模型可能進一步觸發減碼，形成「愈跌愈賣」的負向循環。
高盛的預估顯示，這類基金短期內仍可能是美股的重要賣壓來源，甚至市場反彈也不一定能避免部分賣盤出現。

Anthropic上市未能提振市場 AI投資回報疑慮升高

市場原先期待Anthropic IPO成為資金重返風險資產的轉折點，帶動投資人重新建立信心，並為年底行情注入動能，但實際提振效果有限。
高盛交易員指出，部分投資人原本寄望這項大型科技IPO改善市場情緒，吸引資金重新流入風險資產，但最終結果不如預期。高盛交易員形容，這樣的結果是「難以下嚥的苦果」。
與此同時，市場對AI巨額資本支出能否轉化為實際收益的疑慮持續升溫。投資人開始重新檢視AI晶片、運算能力及基礎設施投資，是否能創造足夠回報，以支撐科技股目前的估值。
輝達周五單日重挫14%，自10月高點以來跌幅接近50%，成為這波科技股修正的重要拖累。
賣壓也進一步擴散至散戶偏好的股票。高盛追蹤的散戶偏好股組合周五下跌8.9%；此外，高盛追蹤的景氣循環股相對防禦股比較組合下跌3.2%，反映資金正從景氣循環類股轉向防禦型資產。
從CTA持續減碼，到散戶偏好的投機性資產遭到拋售，美股去風險趨勢正進一步擴大。若科技股持續承壓，並觸發更多趨勢追蹤策略減碼，市場恐面臨新一波賣壓。
paras_en: U.S. equity selling pressure has been widening, and Goldman Sachs warns that the market is entering a vicious cycle where selling begets more selling; systematic investors still have large reduction needs that have not yet been released, and the pressure on stocks could intensify over the next week.

According to Bloomberg on Saturday (the 21st), Goldman Sachs traders released a research note on Friday (the 20th) showing that the firm’s market‑sentiment “fear index” has risen to 9 out of 10, indicating that systematic investors’ sell pressure is spreading broadly.

Goldman’s model estimates that even if the market does not fall further, trend‑following funds could still sell several hundred billion dollars of equities over the next week; if the rally continues to weaken, the potential sell pressure would expand further.

The current decline has already battered tech stocks. The Nasdaq‑100 fell 5.6% on Friday, marking its biggest weekly drop since March 2020, while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index plunged 11% and Nvidia (NVDA‑US) has lost nearly 50% from its October 6 peak.

Selling pressure is also spilling over into retail‑favored stocks and crypto‑related assets, showing that hedging sentiment is no longer confined to institutional holdings but is spreading to a broader set of risk assets.

Moreover, the market had hoped that Anthropic’s (ANT‑US) IPO would inject fresh momentum into risk assets, but that expectation has not materialised. At the same time, investors’ doubts about whether massive AI‑infrastructure capital spending can generate sufficient returns are rising, suppressing tech valuations and leaving the market without a clear bottom‑finding signal.

Goldman estimates that trend‑following strategies represented by commodity‑trading advisors (CTAs) have sold $57 billion of equities over the past month, and the net position in U.S. equities has now turned into a net short of $19 billion.

However, institutional reductions may not be over. Goldman’s model projects that if the market stays flat over the next week, CTAs could still sell $65.8 billion of equities; if stocks fall further, potential sales could rise to $80.6 billion; even a rebound could trigger $28.6 billion of selling.

CTAs and other trend‑following strategies automatically adjust their positions based on price movements and volatility. When the market declines, the models may trigger further reductions, creating a “sell more as prices fall” negative feedback loop.
Goldman’s forecasts show that these funds could remain a major source of selling pressure on U.S. stocks in the short term, and even a market rally may not prevent some sell orders from occurring.
The Anthropic IPO failed to lift the market, and concerns about AI investment returns have intensified.

Goldman traders noted that some investors had hoped the large‑cap tech IPO would improve market sentiment and draw capital back into risk assets, but the outcome fell short of expectations. They described the result as a “hard‑to‑swallow bitter fruit.”

At the same time, worries are heating up about whether the huge AI capital expenditures can be turned into real earnings. Investors are re‑examining AI chips, computing power and infrastructure investments to see if they can generate enough returns to justify current tech valuations.
Nvidia slumped 14% on Friday, bringing its decline since the October peak to almost 50% and becoming a key drag on this wave of tech‑stock corrections.

Selling pressure has also spread to retail‑favored stocks. The retail‑preference stock basket tracked by Goldman fell 8.9% on Friday; additionally, Goldman’s cyclical‑vs‑defensive stock comparison basket dropped 3.2%, reflecting a shift of capital from cyclical to defensive assets.

From the ongoing CTA reductions to the sell‑off of retail‑favored speculative assets, the risk‑off trend in U.S. equities is widening. If tech stocks stay under pressure and trigger more trend‑following reductions, the market could face a new wave of selling pressure.

items.title: 狂發30張照片回味APEC！川普曬與普丁合影 標註「我的朋友」
items.title_en: Trump Floods Social Media with 30 Photos Reliving APEC, Posts Putin Photo Labeled “My Friend”
paras: 結束中國深圳的亞太經濟合作會議(APEC)後，美國總統川普周六(21日)在社群平台上，一口氣發表30多張會議照片，高調在與俄羅斯總統普丁的合照標註「我的朋友」(My Friend)，並於白宮記者會與專訪中辯護表示，與擁有4,000枚核武器的國家領導人交友是一件好事。
川普與普丁在APEC期間，舉行了約40分鐘的場邊會談，會前川普在媒體鏡頭前微笑指向普丁稱：「這是誰？這是我的朋友。」
俄羅斯總統外交助理烏沙科夫(Yuri Ushakov)證實，雙方討論了和平解決烏克蘭戰爭的方案，美方特使庫許納(Jared Kushner)澄清，任何協議都會與烏克蘭及歐洲密切協商，絕非單方面強加。
然而，川普高調展現的友誼引發歐洲盟友強烈疑慮。波蘭總理圖斯克(Donald Tusk)在社群平台 X 上感嘆：「願上帝保佑我們免受這種朋友的傷害」，並強調普丁絕非歐洲的朋友。波蘭外長席科爾斯基(Radosław Sikorski)表示，川普擁抱普丁的畫面令人憂心，讓人質疑關鍵時刻川普究竟會選擇波蘭還是普丁。

波蘭國防部長柯西尼亞克-卡密希(Władysław Kosiniak-Kamysz)指出，俄軍連夜以飛彈與無人機侵犯波蘭領空，顯示地緣威脅近在咫尺。此外，烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基(Volodymyr Zelenskyy)對此苦笑攤手未作回應；丹麥首相佛瑞德里克森(Mette Frederiksen)形容會晤「令人極難理解」；德國總理梅爾茨(Friedrich Merz)則警告切莫讓會談演變為二戰末期瓜分歐洲的「雅爾達會議」重演。
不過，部分盟友試圖緩和氛圍。英國首相柏南(Andy Burnham)指出，川普並未陷於普丁的魅力攻勢，反而在會中極為關切戰爭造成的慘重生命損失；北約秘書長呂特(Mark Rutte)也為核武大國外交對話的必要性進行辯護。
對於主辦城市深圳，川普盛讚城市發展規模與成就。川普返回美國後召開記者會表示，深圳「完美得無可挑剔」。他指出深圳僅在短短 40 年內，就從一座小漁村發展成如今的現代化大都市規模。
川普特別提到自己仔細觀察了深圳的基礎建設，稱讚其道路與護欄不僅沒有坑坑窪窪，甚至連修補補綴的痕跡都沒有，並對當地的建設與維護工作表達了高度尊重。
在深圳期間，川普讚許深圳是「非常棒的城市」，同時感到遺憾與「惋惜」，認為媒體的報導遠無法完整展現這座城市的全景。
paras_en: After the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit in Shenzhen, China, U.S. President Donald Trump posted more than 30 photos from the meeting on Saturday (the 21st), boldly labeling a picture with Russian President Vladimir Putin as “My Friend” and defending the friendship at a White House press briefing and interview, saying it’s a good thing to be friends with the leader of a nation that possesses 4,000 nuclear weapons.
During APEC, Trump and Putin held a roughly 40‑minute side meeting. Before the talks, Trump smiled at the cameras and pointed at Putin, saying, “Who’s this? This is my friend.”

Russian presidential aide Yuri Ushakov confirmed that the two leaders discussed a peaceful solution to the war in Ukraine. U.S. envoy Jared Kushner clarified that any agreement would be negotiated closely with Ukraine and Europe, not imposed unilaterally.

Trump’s high‑profile display of friendship sparked strong concerns among European allies. Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk wrote on X, “May God protect us from the harm of such friends,” stressing that Putin is not Europe’s friend. Polish Foreign Minister Radosław Sikorski said the image of Trump embracing Putin was worrisome and raised doubts about whether Trump would side with Poland or Putin in a critical moment.

Polish Defence Minister Władysław Kosiniak‑Kamysz noted that Russian forces overnight violated Polish airspace with missiles and drones, showing the geographic threat is immediate. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy merely smiled wryly and gave no comment; Danish Prime Minister Mette Frederiksen called the meeting “hard to understand”; German Chancellor Friedrich Merz warned that the talks must not turn into a post‑World‑War‑II “Yalta”‑type partition of Europe.

Some allies tried to soften the atmosphere. British Prime Minister Andy Burnham said Trump was not swayed by Putin’s charm offensive but was deeply concerned about the massive loss of life caused by the war; NATO Secretary‑General Mark Rutte also defended the necessity of diplomatic dialogue between nuclear‑armed powers.

Trump praised Shenzhen’s scale of development and achievements. After returning to the United States, he held a press conference calling Shenzhen “perfectly flawless,” noting that in just 40 years the city had grown from a small fishing village into a modern metropolis.

Trump specifically said he had closely observed Shenzhen’s infrastructure, complimenting its roads and guardrails for being free of potholes and even lacking any repair marks, and expressed high respect for the city’s construction and maintenance work.
While in Shenzhen, Trump described the city as “a very great city,” while also expressing regret and “sorrow,” saying media coverage falls far short of fully portraying the city’s full picture.

items.title: 馬斯克警告：AI產業2027年將面臨數千億美元資金短缺危機
items.title_en: Musk Warns AI Industry Could Face a Multi‑Hundred‑Billion‑Dollar Funding Shortfall by 2027
paras: 特斯拉(TSLA-US)執行長馬斯克(Elon Musk)周六(21日)警告，全球人工智慧(AI)產業在 2027 年，恐將迎來高達數千億美元的資金短缺危機。
馬斯克在社群平台 X 上與 AI 研究員François Chollet對談時表示，儘管市場對算力的需求依然旺盛，但產業正面臨「在收益進帳前就把現金耗盡」的財務瓶頸。
AI 研究員Chollet指出，目前全球對算力的需求極為強勁，GPU 顯示卡現貨價格持續攀升，高頻寬記憶體(HBM)與 DRAM 產能早已被訂購一空。對此，馬斯克回應強調，危機的核心在於硬體採購與實現獲利之間的時間差，而非需求不足。企業必須在獲得客戶付費前數月，提前採購晶片、興建數據中心、爭取龐大電力並建置冷卻系統。
馬斯克說：「讓如此大規模的算力上線、冷卻並穩定運作極為困難。購買算力到穩定變現之間只要出現幾個月的延遲，就會創造出數千億美元的額外營運資金缺口。」
此外，電力與基礎設施瓶頸進一步延緩部署，馬斯克先前亦預估 2027 年全球 AI 晶片部署將面臨至少 15 GW 的電力缺口。
高盛的數據顯示，2026 年全球 AI 相關資本支出已逼近 1 兆美元，累積債務發行量高達約 6,000 億美元。馬斯克透露，旗下 SpaceX 雖於 2026 年 10 月完成約 400 億美元的債務融資以購入 GPU，但他警告，債務市場對缺乏數據中心以外實質營收的新興雲端服務商(neocloud providers)正迅速關閉融資大門。
在信貸緊縮與投資人態度轉趨謹慎下，馬斯克預測，AI 數據中心領域將有超過 200 家企業面臨併購潮或直接倒閉。
paras_en: Tesla (TSLA-US) CEO Elon Musk warned on Saturday (the 21st) that the global artificial intelligence (AI) industry could encounter a funding shortfall of up to several hundred billion dollars by 2027.

In a conversation on the X platform with AI researcher François Chollet, Musk said that although demand for compute power remains strong, the industry is hitting a financial bottleneck of "burning cash before any revenue comes in."

Chollet noted that worldwide demand for compute is extremely strong, GPU spot prices keep climbing, and capacity for high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) and DRAM has already been fully booked. Musk replied that the crisis stems from the time lag between hardware procurement and profit realization, not from insufficient demand. Companies must purchase chips, build data centers, secure massive power supplies and install cooling systems months before customers actually pay.

Musk said: "Getting such massive compute online, cooled and running reliably is extremely difficult. A delay of just a few months between buying compute and turning it into stable revenue creates an extra operating‑capital gap of several hundred billion dollars."
He added that power‑and‑infrastructure bottlenecks further slow deployment, and Musk previously estimated that global AI‑chip deployment will face at least a 15 GW power shortfall in 2027.

Goldman Sachs data show that global AI‑related capital spending is approaching $1 trillion in 2026, with cumulative debt issuance around $600 billion. Musk disclosed that SpaceX completed roughly $40 billion of debt financing in October 2026 to buy GPUs, but warned that the debt market is rapidly shutting its doors to emerging cloud providers (neocloud providers) that lack data‑center‑related revenue beyond the hardware itself.
Amid tightening credit and more cautious investors, Musk predicts that over 200 companies in the AI data‑center space will face a wave of mergers and acquisitions or outright failure.

items.title: 伊朗宣稱擊中巴林美軍雷達 沙烏地攔截一枚飛彈
items.title_en: Iran Claims to Hit US Radar in Bahrain, Saudi Arabia Intercepts a Missile
paras: 伊朗伊斯蘭革命衛隊(IRGC)周六(21日)宣稱發射飛彈與無人機，擊中美軍設於巴林的防空雷達系統，以報復美軍侵犯其領空及襲擊雷達站。另一方面，沙烏地阿拉伯成功攔截襲擊其重要原油出口終端站的飛彈，而荷姆茲海峽周邊接連發生油輪遇襲事件。
根據伊朗國營媒體報導，革命衛隊針對巴林阿爾里法(al-Riffa)與阿瓦利(Awali)基地的美軍愛國者防空雷達發動打擊。巴林內政部證實一處民營工業設施在「伊朗侵略」中起火，所幸無人傷亡，隨後發布安全解除通知。革命衛隊還宣稱在荷姆茲海峽擊落美軍MQ-9與MQ-1無人機。
此外，由沙烏地主導的聯軍表示，已成功攔截並摧毀一枚朝向沙烏地西部延布(Yanbu)原油出口終端站發射的胡塞組織(青年運動)彈道飛彈，以及先前飛往利雅德的無人機。
伊朗外交政策與國家安全委員會發言人Ebrahim Rezaei警告，若伊朗的煉油廠或電廠遭襲，伊朗將全力打擊以色列的基礎設施。伊朗副外長Kazem Gharibabadi指責美國的經濟封鎖是「戰爭行為」，並強調濃縮核原料「在任何情況下」都不會移出伊朗。
伊朗軍方發言人准將Mohammad Akraminia表示，美國任何新侵略都將面臨「果斷且立即的回應」，美方必須接受伊朗條件以結束戰爭。
美國總統川普周六接受採訪時重申，他希望達成一項永久協議，阻止伊朗獲得核武器，即使「在4年、15年或20年後，我們迎來一位無能的總統」。
他形容伊朗領導層「非常難對付，且經常在協議達成次日毀約」。
針對伊朗宣稱擊傷美軍戰機的說法，美軍中央司令部予以否認，強調中東地區所有美軍F-16戰鬥機均安全無虞。
航運安全方面，英國海事貿易行動辦公室(UKMTO)指出，兩艘離開荷姆茲海峽的油輪在阿曼外海遭「不明拋射物」擊中，海峽威脅等級已調升至「嚴重」。
海峽船隻通行量較戰前驟降約65%，受到衝突衝擊，倫敦布蘭特原油期貨價格維持在每桶83.62美元的高位，顯著高於戰前水準。
paras_en: Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) said on Saturday (the 21st) that it launched missiles and drones that struck a US air‑defense radar system stationed in Bahrain, claiming retaliation for US incursions into its airspace and attacks on radar sites. Meanwhile, Saudi Arabia successfully intercepted a missile aimed at a key oil‑export terminal, and a series of attacks on tankers have occurred around the Hormuz Strait.

According to Iran’s state media, the Revolutionary Guard targeted US Patriot air‑defense radars at the al‑Riffa and Awali bases in Bahrain. Bahrain’s interior ministry confirmed that a private industrial facility caught fire during the "Iranian aggression," but there were no casualties and a safety clearance was later issued. The Guard also claimed to have shot down US MQ‑9 and MQ‑1 drones over the Hormuz Strait.

In addition, a Saudi‑led coalition said it had successfully intercepted and destroyed a ballistic missile launched by the Houthi youth movement toward the Yanbu oil‑export terminal in western Saudi Arabia, as well as a drone that was previously heading toward Riyadh.

Ebrahim Rezaei, spokesperson for Iran’s Foreign Policy and National Security Committee, warned that if Iran’s refineries or power plants were attacked, Iran would fully strike Israeli infrastructure. Deputy Foreign Minister Kazem Gharibabadi accused the United States of an "act of war" with its economic blockade and stressed that enriched nuclear material would not be moved out of Iran under any circumstances.

Iranian military spokesman Brigadier General Mohammad Akraminia said any new US aggression would meet a "decisive and immediate response," and that the United States must accept Iran’s conditions to end the war.

U.S. President Donald Trump reiterated in an interview on Saturday that he wants a permanent deal to prevent Iran from acquiring nuclear weapons, even if "in four, fifteen or twenty years we get an incompetent president."
He described Iran’s leadership as "very difficult to deal with and often reneges on agreements the day after they are reached."
The US Central Command denied Iran's claim of having damaged US aircraft, emphasizing that all US F‑16 fighter jets in the Middle East remain safe and operational.

Regarding maritime safety, the United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) reported that two tankers leaving the Hormuz Strait were hit by "unidentified projectiles" in Omani waters, prompting the threat level for the strait to be raised to "severe."
Ship traffic through the strait has fallen about 65% from pre‑war levels due to the conflict, while London Brent crude futures have stayed high at $83.62 a barrel, well above pre‑war prices.

items.title: 全美融資餘額自1.5兆美元高點回落 那斯達克指數跌入修正區
items.title_en: U.S. Margin Debt Falls From $1.5 Trillion Peak as Nasdaq Slides Into Correction Zone
paras: 隨著美國股市高檔震盪，市場風險偏好出現鬆動跡象。根據數據統計，截至 10 月，全美融資餘額(Margin Debt)已從今年 6 月創下的 1.502 兆美元歷史新高，回落至 1.448 兆美元，短短數月內滑落約 540 億美元。
這波融資去槓桿適逢美股科技股賣壓湧現，以科技股為主體的那斯達克指數自近期高點拉回近 12%，正式跌入修正區域，而標普 500 指數則仍在歷史高檔附近徘徊。
針對融資餘額的急劇變動，《The Motley Fool》專欄分析師Sean Williams警告，融資債務一直是衡量市場過度投機的關鍵指標。Williams指出，自 1998 年以來，美股共出現四次融資債務在短期內呈拋物線飆升逾 65% 至 80% 以上的情形，而前三次最終皆引發市場重挫：
1999 年 3 月至 2000 年 3 月(網路泡沫)：融資債務在 12 個月內暴增 80% 至近 3,000 億美元，隨後標普 500 指數與那斯達克指數分別崩跌 49% 與 78%。
2006 年 6 月至 2007 年 7 月(次貸金融危機)：融資債務於 13 個月內激增 66% 至約 4,160 億美元，隨後爆發大蕭條，標普 500 指數大跌 57%。
2020 年 3 月至 2021 年 10 月(疫情資金浪潮)：融資債務在 19 個月內暴增 95% 至 9,360 億美元，直接引發 2022 年熊市，那斯達克指數修正幅度達 33%。
2025 年 4 月至 2026 年 6 月：融資債務在 14 個月內急升 77% 至 1.502 兆美元新高。
Williams強調，借貸資金雖能放大獲利，但也會加劇虧損；當投資人在融資拋物線大增後開始減碼去槓桿，歷史經驗顯示這往往是市場見頂與泡沫破裂的重大警訊，而非單純的短暫休整。
在人工智慧(AI)浪潮推升股市之際，波克夏海瑟威(Berkshire Hathaway)前執行長華倫·巴菲特(Warren Buffett)早年的警語重新引發關注。巴菲特曾在 1999 年《Fortune》雜誌撰文指出，技術變革與投資報酬是兩回事。他以航空業為例，儘管航空技術改變了人類生活，但在過去二十年間卻有 129 家航空公司破產；電視與廣播產業亦然，未能持續為股東創造長期報酬。
巴菲特當時強調：「投資的關鍵不在於評估一個行業會對社會產生多大影響或成長多少，而是確定任何給定公司的競爭優勢，最重要的是此優勢的持久性。」
Williams認為，這項原則同樣適用於當前的 AI 產業浪潮。
paras_en: As the U.S. equity market trades in a high‑level range, market risk appetite shows signs of loosening. According to data, by October the total U.S. margin debt had retreated from the historic high of $1.502 trillion set in June to $1.448 trillion, a drop of roughly $54 billion in just a few months.

This deleveraging of margin debt coincides with a surge of selling pressure on U.S. tech stocks. The Nasdaq index, which is heavily weighted toward technology, has pulled back nearly 12% from recent highs and officially entered correction territory, while the S&P 500 remains near its historic peaks.

Regarding the sharp swing in margin debt, Motley Fool columnist Sean Williams warned that margin debt is a key gauge of market over‑speculation. Williams noted that since 1998 the U.S. market has experienced four episodes in which margin debt surged parabolically by more than 65%‑80% over a short period, and the first three all culminated in steep market declines:
March 1999 – March 2000 (dot‑com bubble): margin debt exploded by about 80% in 12 months to nearly $300 billion, after which the S&P 500 and Nasdaq fell 49% and 78% respectively.
June 2006 – July 2007 (sub‑prime crisis): margin debt jumped 66% in 13 months to roughly $416 billion, preceding the Great Recession and a 57% plunge in the S&P 500.
March 2020 – October 2021 (pandemic liquidity wave): margin debt surged 95% over 19 months to $936 billion, directly triggering the 2022 bear market and a 33% correction in the Nasdaq.
April 2025 – June 2026: margin debt rose 77% in 14 months to a new high of $1.502 trillion.

Williams emphasized that borrowed money can amplify gains but also magnifies losses; when investors start cutting back and deleveraging after a parabolic rise in margin debt, history shows this is often a major warning sign of a market top and bubble burst rather than a mere short‑term pause.

Amid the AI‑driven market rally, early remarks by former Berkshire Hathaway CEO Warren Buffett have resurfaced. In a 1999 Fortune article, Buffett warned that technological change and investment returns are separate matters. He cited the airline industry, noting that despite transformative technology, 129 airlines have gone bankrupt over the past two decades, and made a similar point about TV and radio firms failing to deliver lasting shareholder returns.

Buffett stressed at the time: “The key to investing is not to assess how much impact an industry will have on society or how fast it will grow, but to determine a given company’s competitive advantage, and most importantly, the durability of that advantage.”
Williams believes the same principle applies to today’s AI industry wave.

items.title: 2018年劇本重演？美股暴跌 投資人質疑聯準會緊縮政策
items.title_en: Is 2018 Repeating? US Stocks Plunge, Investors Question Fed Tightening Policy
paras: 全球金融市場近期再掀波瀾，美股持續下挫與金融條件急劇緊縮，使市場瀰漫著與2018年末高度相似的危險氣息。在聯準會(Fed)升息預期居高不下之際，投資人強烈疑慮貨幣政策緊縮恐將進一步加劇市場動盪。

2018年恐慌：清倉式變現與緊縮陰霾

美股近期遭遇嚴峻賣壓，標普500指數連續六個交易日收跌，跌破200日均線，盤中甚至出現漲幅逾1%後逆轉重挫2%的劇烈波動。全數11個產業類股無一倖免，連公用事業與日常消費品等傳統防禦性類股也同步倒地。
針對此輪重挫，高盛交易主管 Rich Privorotsky 在最新報告中指出，當前市場賣壓並非傳統的「類股輪動」，而是屬於「全面清倉式變現」。Privorotsky 警告，市場正經歷從風險偏好下降轉向更深層流動性收縮的危險階段。
同時，高盛美國金融條件指數(FCI)總經籃子升至124.48，創下過去一年新高，顯示金融條件正以罕見速度急速緊縮。

2018年末升息過度迫使聯準會「轉向」

當前市場情勢與2018年四季度如出一轍。2018年聯準會全年四次升息，並於12月將聯邦基金利率區間上調至2.25%—2.50%。隨後，標普500指數自9月高點一路重挫至12月24日低點，累計跌幅達19.8%，逼近技術性熊市。
歷史經驗顯示，持續累積的市場壓力最終倒逼貨幣政策轉向。2019年1月30日，聯準會公開表態未來調整利率時將「保持耐心」，釋出明確的暫停升息訊號，美股隨即迎來顯著反彈。
Privorotsky 分析指出，當前市場同樣面臨金融條件緊縮與經濟成長承壓的雙重威脅，政策立場與市場現實之間的矛盾正在持續加深。

黃金失守透露流動性危機

聯準會官員近期密集釋放鷹派訊息，加劇了市場恐慌。聯準會理事華勒公開提及升息50個基點(2碼)的可能性，配合會議紀錄中對持續升息的支持立場，不僅拉高資本成本，也使人工智慧(AI)基礎建設投資的回報預期大受打擊。
更值得注意的是跨資產的異常聯動。通常作為避險資產的黃金，此次竟與股市同步暴跌，金價跌破每盎司3600美元，銅價出現單日大跌約5%的劇烈下挫。
Privorotsky 強調，黃金是觀察當前流動性危機深度的最佳指標；股票與黃金同步被拋售，意味著投資人不再只是轉移資產，而是變現求現，反映出整體金融系統的流動性收縮。
澳盛銀行(ANZ)對此進一步補充，黃金投機性多頭目前仍有約200噸的潛在減碼空間，意味著市場去槓桿的壓力可能尚未完全釋放完畢。

政策催化劑何時顯現？

儘管悲觀情緒籠罩，Privorotsky 認為當前單邊去槓桿的規模顯示美股可能已接近戰術性低點。由於法人機構倉位已明顯低配，一旦出現正面催化劑，反彈幅度將相當劇烈。在操作策略上，Privorotsky 繼續看好「做多短天期國債」，認為債市已開始為聯準會的政策失誤訂價。
然而，真正的趨勢扭轉仍賴於政策預期的明確改變。目前高盛經濟學家團隊仍預測聯準會將於12月升息25個基點(1碼)，並於2027年3月再次升息，這與債券市場的訂價存在顯著分歧。
Privorotsky 研判，雖然市場正密切關注 PCE 物價指數與非農就業報告，但真正能迫使聯準會重新評估政策路徑的，恐將是後續公布的 11 月 CPI 消費者物價指數。
paras_en: Global financial markets have recently been roiled again, with US equities continuing to fall and financial conditions tightening sharply, creating a danger reminiscent of late 2018. With expectations of further Fed rate hikes remaining high, investors are deeply concerned that monetary tightening could further exacerbate market turbulence.

2018 panic: forced liquidation and tightening gloom

US stocks have recently faced severe selling pressure, with the S&P 500 closing lower for six consecutive trading days and slipping below its 200‑day moving average. Intraday the index even swung from a gain of more than 1% to a plunge of about 2% in a volatile reversal. All 11 industry sectors were hit, including traditionally defensive utilities and consumer staples, which also fell hard.

Regarding this sharp sell‑off, Goldman Sachs trading head Rich Privorotsky noted in a new report that the current market pressure is not a typical sector rotation but a “full‑blown liquidation.” Privorotsky warned that the market is moving from a decline in risk appetite to a deeper phase of liquidity contraction.
At the same time, Goldman Sachs’ US Financial Conditions Index (FCI) rose to 124.48, a one‑year high, indicating that financial conditions are tightening at an unusually rapid pace.

Late‑2018 rate hikes forced the Fed to “turn around”

The present market situation mirrors the fourth quarter of 2018. In 2018 the Fed raised rates four times and in December lifted the federal‑funds target range to 2.25%‑2.50%. Subsequently the S&P 500 fell from its September peak to a low on Dec. 24, a cumulative drop of 19.8%, edging toward a technical bear market.

Historical experience shows that sustained market pressure eventually forces a policy pivot. On Jan. 30, 2019 the Fed publicly said it would “remain patient” when adjusting rates, signalling a clear pause in hikes, and US stocks promptly rallied.

Privorotsky analysis points out that the market now faces a dual threat of tightening financial conditions and pressured economic growth, deepening the conflict between policy stance and market reality.

Gold loses its safe‑haven status, revealing a liquidity crisis

Fed officials have recently been issuing hawkish messages, heightening market fear. Fed Governor Christopher Waller publicly mentioned the possibility of a 50‑basis‑point (½‑point) rate hike, and meeting minutes showed continued support for further tightening, which not only raises capital costs but also sharply dents expected returns on AI infrastructure investments.

More noteworthy is the abnormal cross‑asset linkage. Gold, usually a hedge asset, this time fell in lockstep with equities, slipping below $3,600 per ounce, while copper plunged about 5% in a single day.

Privorotsky emphasized that gold is the best gauge of the depth of the current liquidity crisis; simultaneous selling of stocks and gold means investors are not merely reallocating assets but are cashing out, reflecting a contraction of liquidity across the financial system.
ANZ added that speculative long positions in gold still have roughly 200 tons of potential reduction, suggesting that de‑leveraging pressure may not yet be fully exhausted.

When will a policy catalyst appear?

Despite the gloom, Privorotsky believes the scale of the current one‑sided de‑leveraging indicates US equities may be near a tactical bottom. With institutional positions already under‑weighted, any positive catalyst could trigger a sharp rebound. Strategically, Privorotsky continues to favor “long short‑term Treasury bonds,” arguing that the bond market is beginning to price in the Fed’s policy missteps.

However, a true trend reversal still depends on a clear shift in policy expectations. Goldman Sachs economists still forecast a 25‑basis‑point (¼‑point) Fed hike in December and another in March 2027, a view that diverges markedly from bond‑market pricing.

Privorotsky judges that while the market is watching the PCE price index and the non‑farm payroll report closely, the data point most likely to force the Fed to reassess its policy path will be the upcoming November CPI consumer price index.

items.title: 美股慘崩 AI產業是泡沫破裂還是價格重估？
items.title_en: U.S. Stocks Plummet: Is the AI Industry Facing a Bubble Burst or a Price Re‑valuation?
paras: 近期美國股市遭遇強烈賣壓，先前引領華爾街牛市的人工智慧(AI)概念股顯著拉回，帶動主要股指陷入技術性修正區間。市場對科技巨頭龐大資本支出能否轉化為實際商業回報的疑慮逐漸升溫，加上總經利率政策與企業管理層變動等因素，引發投資人對 AI 投資熱潮永續性的廣泛討論。

科技股賣壓席捲華爾街

那斯達克指數本周重挫 10%，創下 2020 年 3 月以來最劇烈的單周跌幅，自 10 月 6 日創下的歷史高點 27,599.79 點累計回撤約 18%，回吐 2026 年以來全部漲幅。
根據 CNN 統計數據，那斯達克指數自高點以來蒸發市值約 8.7 兆美元。同時，標普 500 指數連續七個交易日下跌，創下 2020 年 2 月以來最長連跌紀錄，與道瓊工業平均指數雙雙自高點回撤逾 10%，正式進入技術性修正區間。反映市場恐慌情緒的 VIX 指數則升至 35.89，達近 19 個月高點。
半導體與雲端基礎設施類股同樣承壓。費城半導體指數單日暴跌 10.7%，iShares 半導體 ETF(SOXX-US)單周下跌 17.4%，自歷史高點累計回撤約 43%。新興 AI 雲端服務供應商 CoreWeave 股價跌至 39.51 美元，低於其上市發行價；AMD 與 Alphabet 單周分別下跌 20.5% 與 10.3%，顯示市場賣壓已擴及整個 AI 供應鏈。

輝達高層異動與 Anthropic 上市考驗

市場關注焦點之一為半導體龍頭輝達(NVDA-US)的劇烈波動。輝達單周股價重挫約 23%，創 2008 年 10 月以來最大單周跌幅，自 10 月高點回撤 47.5%，市值蒸發約 2.7 兆美元。輝達近期面臨前執行長黃仁勳離職及美國證券交易委員會(SEC)會計處理調查等管理層與合規疑慮。儘管輝達最新季度財報優於市場預期並給出強勁展望，仍未能阻止股價下跌。
另一方面，AI 初創企業 Anthropic(ANT-US) 完成估值 810 億美元的首次公開發行(IPO)，每股定價 83 美元。雖然掛牌首日上漲 17%，但隨後股價拉回至 88.91 美元，吐出大部分首日漲幅。市場原先期待 Anthropic 的上市能為科技股注入強心針，但此一效應未能持續。

升息預期與債務融資風險

科技股承壓的背景還包含宏觀經濟與政策環境的轉變。美國聯準會於 9 月進行升息，且市場預期 12 月可能持續調升利率，提高了資料中心建設與基礎設施擴充的融資成本。政治層面上，美國國會期中選舉後，立法機關針對 AI 資料中心建設與相關法規提出更嚴格的審查主張。
歐洲央行(ECB)11 月報告估計，美國主要科技巨頭至 2030 年在 AI 基礎設施上的累計資本支出可能達到 5.5 兆美元，且對債務融資的依賴度持續上升。分析指出，輝達對 CoreWeave 等 AI 開發商與雲端業者的投資及融資關係，形成了緊密的產業生態系，當部分企業面臨資金或獲利壓力時，可能產生連鎖反應。

估值重估與泡沫疑慮之辯

對此輪下跌意義，市場看法高度分歧。Acadian Asset Management 投資組合經理Owen Lamont評估美國股市處於泡沫狀態的機率達 70%，指出高估值、投機熱潮、新股發行與資金湧入等四大警訊皆已顯現。
Haverford Trust 投資策略主管Hank Smith認為，當前 AI 熱潮背後有 Meta、蘋果與輝達等具備實質獲利之龍頭企業支持，非空想泡沫；但市場需要時間修復，AI 類股可能在未來一段時間內暫時失寵。
摩根大通資產管理首席策略師David Kelly表示，認為美股在經歷大幅上漲後出現技術性修正屬正常現象，將當前波動形容為「輕微感冒」，未必代表嚴重系統性危機。
LPL Financial 首席固定收益策略師Lawrence Gillum指出，當前拉回「並非泡沫破裂」，AI 投資週期仍有持續運作的空間。
Treasury Partners 首席投資長Richard Saperstein分析，將此輪下挫歸因於「AI 價格重估」，主因為資料中心建設放緩與融資環境收緊。
Jones Trading 策略師Mike O'Rourke強調，輝達與黃仁勳被視為 AI 基礎建設熱潮的象徵，當市場對其透明度與可信度產生疑慮時，整體市場信心必然受到衝擊。
paras_en: Recent U.S. equity markets have been hit by strong selling pressure, pulling back the AI‑related stocks that previously led Wall Street’s bull market and pushing major indices into a technical correction zone. Concerns are rising that the massive capital expenditures of tech giants may not translate into real commercial returns, and together with macro‑policy interest‑rate moves and changes in corporate leadership, investors are broadly debating the sustainability of the AI investment frenzy.

Tech‑stock selling pressure sweeps Wall Street. The Nasdaq fell about 10% this week, marking its steepest single‑week decline since March 2020, and has retreated roughly 18% from its October 6 all‑time high of 27,599.79 points, erasing all gains made since 2026.

According to CNN data, the Nasdaq has shed about $8.7 trillion in market value since its peak. At the same time, the S&P 500 has fallen for seven consecutive trading days, the longest losing streak since February 2020, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average has also pulled back more than 10% from its highs, officially entering a technical correction zone. The VIX, reflecting market fear, rose to 35.89, a near‑19‑month high.

Semiconductor and cloud‑infrastructure stocks are also under pressure. The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index plunged 10.7% in a single day, and the iShares Semiconductor ETF (SOXX‑US) fell 17.4% over the week, representing about a 43% decline from its historic peak. Emerging AI cloud provider CoreWeave slid to $39.51, below its IPO price; AMD and Alphabet fell 20.5% and 10.3% respectively over the week, showing that the sell‑off has spread across the entire AI supply chain.

Nvidia’s leadership shake‑up and Anthropic’s IPO test the market. One focal point is the dramatic volatility of semiconductor leader Nvidia (NVDA‑US), whose stock dropped roughly 23% for the week – the biggest weekly decline since October 2008 – retreating 47.5% from its October high and wiping out about $2.7 trillion in market value. Nvidia recently faced the departure of former CEO Jensen Huang and an SEC accounting‑practice investigation, raising governance and compliance concerns. Even though Nvidia’s latest quarterly results beat expectations and offered a strong outlook, the stock kept falling.

On the other hand, AI startup Anthropic (ANT‑US) completed an IPO valuing it at $81 billion, pricing shares at $83 each. Although the stock jumped 17% on debut, it quickly fell back to $88.91, giving back most of its first‑day gains. The market had initially hoped Anthropic’s listing would inject fresh vigor into tech stocks, but that effect proved short‑lived.

Rising‑rate expectations and debt‑financing risks. The backdrop to the tech‑stock pressure also includes macro‑economic and policy shifts. The Federal Reserve raised rates in September and markets anticipate further hikes in December, increasing financing costs for data‑center construction and infrastructure expansion. Politically, after the U.S. mid‑term elections, Congress is proposing stricter scrutiny of AI data‑center projects and related regulations.

The European Central Bank’s November report estimates that U.S. tech giants could spend up to $5.5 trillion on AI infrastructure through 2030, with growing reliance on debt financing. Analysts note that Nvidia’s investments and financing ties with AI developers such as CoreWeave and cloud providers create a tightly knit ecosystem, so financial or profitability pressures on some firms could trigger a chain reaction.

Valuation re‑assessment and bubble‑risk debate. Opinions diverge sharply on the meaning of this sell‑off. Acadian Asset Management portfolio manager Owen Lamont estimates a 70% probability that the U.S. market is in a bubble, citing four warning signs: lofty valuations, speculative hype, new‑issue sprees and massive capital inflows.

Haverford Trust’s investment‑strategy head Hank Smith argues that the current AI boom is backed by profit‑generating leaders like Meta, Apple and Nvidia, not a fanciful bubble, but the market needs time to heal and AI stocks may remain out of favor for a while.

JPMorgan Asset Management chief strategist David Kelly says that a technical correction after a sharp rally is normal, describing the current volatility as a “slight cold” that does not necessarily signal a serious systemic crisis.
LPL Financial chief fixed‑income strategist Lawrence Gillum notes that the pull‑back “is not a bubble burst” and that the AI investment cycle still has room to operate.

Treasury Partners chief investment officer Richard Saperstein attributes the recent dip to an “AI price re‑valuation,” driven mainly by a slowdown in data‑center construction and tighter financing conditions.

Jones Trading strategist Mike O'Rourke emphasizes that Nvidia and Jensen Huang are seen as symbols of the AI infrastructure boom; when doubts arise about their transparency and credibility, overall market confidence is inevitably shaken.

items.title: 美股恐慌指數VIX飆升至40 市場究竟在擔心什麼？
items.title_en: US Stock Panic Index VIX Spikes to 40 – What Is the Market Really Worried About?
paras: 華爾街周五(20日)遭逢慘烈拋售，被譽為「恐慌指數」的芝加哥選擇權交易所波動率指數(VIX)一度暴升至 40 關卡，收在 35.89，單日大漲逾 26%，創下自 2025 年 4 月關稅動盪以來的最高紀錄。
《Barron’s》報導指出，這通常意味著兩件事：投資人不再相信人工智慧預測的數據，而且，儘管難以置信，拋售潮可能即將結束。
受到 AI 科技股拋售潮蔓延影響，標普 500 指數重挫 3.70%、那斯達克指數大跌 5.28%，道瓊指數重挫 1.93%，三大指數均已陷入技術性修正區間。
其中，晶片巨頭輝達(NVDA-US)因執行長黃仁勳離職風波及監管機構調查會計問題的報導，單日暴跌約 14%、單周重挫 23%。人工智慧新星 Anthropic (ANT-US)掛牌第二日同樣下挫近 10%。
晨星(Morningstar)分析師 Michael Field 認為，Anthropic 上市所帶來的解脫感「已經徹底結束」；盛寶銀行(Saxo)分析師 Charu Chanana 指出，市場「不再僅僅尋求 AI 需求的證明」。
負責編製這一指標的 Cboe 全球市場公司，其衍生性商品市場情報主管 Mandy Xu 指出，VIX 的上漲更多是因應標普 500 指數下跌 3.6% 所產生的「機械性反應」，而非市場因極度恐慌而瘋狂搶購避險工具所致。她表示：「短期內的不確定性確實大增，但不代表恐懼情緒也隨之大幅升高。」
她解釋，指數上漲有超過八成屬於標普 500 大跌產生的連鎖反應與機械式定價調整，而非市場急於購買下行保護的恐慌性搶購。
雖然 VIX 升至 30 點以上確實反映了市場壓力，但這類情況通常一年會發生數次，且持續時間往往不超過幾天。
同時，歷史數據顯示，VIX 觸及 40 通常是潛在買進訊號。歷史上當 VIX 達到 40 後，標普 500 指數在隨後 6 個月內多半能反彈約 20%。
儘管如此，仍有一些投資人押注波動率將會持續下去。Thompson Capital Management 管理合夥人 Matthew Thompson 仍表示：「VIX 出現大幅右尾走勢的條件可能已經成熟。」
paras_en: Wall Street suffered a brutal sell‑off on Friday (the 20th), with the Chicago Board Options Exchange’s volatility index (VIX), known as the “fear gauge,” briefly soaring to the 40 level and closing at 35.89, up more than 26% in a single day – the highest jump since the tariff turmoil of April 2025.
Barron’s reported that this usually signals two things: investors no longer trust AI‑generated forecasts, and, unbelievably, the selling frenzy may be nearing its end.

The AI tech‑stock sell‑off spread to the broader market, dragging the S&P 500 down 3.70%, the Nasdaq off 5.28% and the Dow Jones down 1.93%, with all three major indices now in technical correction territory.

Chip giant Nvidia (NVDA‑US) plunged about 14% in one day and 23% over the week after reports of CEO Jensen Huang’s departure and a regulator’s probe into accounting issues, while AI newcomer Anthropic (ANT‑US) fell nearly 10% on its second trading day.

Morningstar analyst Michael Field said the relief brought by Anthropic’s IPO “has completely vanished”; Saxo analyst Charu Chanana added that the market “is no longer just looking for proof of AI demand.”

Mandy Xu, head of market intelligence for derivatives at Cboe Global Markets, which compiles the VIX, said the index’s rise was largely a “mechanical reaction” to the S&P 500’s 3.6% drop rather than a panic‑driven rush for safe‑haven assets. She noted, “Short‑term uncertainty has indeed surged, but that doesn’t mean fear sentiment has risen proportionally.”
She explained that over 80% of the VIX’s increase stemmed from the chain reaction and formulaic pricing adjustments triggered by the S&P 500’s plunge, not from frantic buying of downside protection.
While a VIX above 30 does reflect market pressure, such spikes typically occur several times a year and usually last only a few days.
Historical data show that a VIX reaching 40 often serves as a buying signal; historically, after the VIX hits 40, the S&P 500 has tended to rebound roughly 20% within the following six months.

Nevertheless, some investors still bet that volatility will persist. Matthew Thompson, managing partner at Thompson Capital Management, said, “The conditions for a pronounced right‑tail move in the VIX may already be in place.”

items.title: 川普要求與伊朗達成「永久」核協議！荷姆茲海峽兩油輪遇襲
items.title_en: Trump Demands a "Permanent" Nuclear Deal with Iran! Two Tankers Attacked in the Hormuz Strait
paras: 美國總統川普周六（21日）表示，他希望達成一項永久性協議，阻止伊朗取得核武，即使「4年、15年或20年後，我們有一位不稱職的總統」，這項協議仍應持續有效。在川普發表上述談話之際，阿曼外海兩艘油輪遭到攻擊。
根據《Investing.com》報導，川普接受《福斯新聞》訪問時，形容伊朗領導層「可能比較講理，但非常、非常難以應付」。他表示，即使雙方達成協議，伊朗也可能隔天就違反承諾。
川普並稱，他已兩度撤換伊朗領導層，目前正面對第三批領導人，並將這種情況形容為「終極政權更替」。
與此同時，英國海事貿易行動辦公室（UKMTO）表示，兩艘油輪在駛離荷姆茲海峽時遭到「不明飛行物」擊中。其中一艘在距離阿曼海岸城市海塞卜（Khasab）以北11海里的海域，船尾遭到攻擊；另一艘則在以東17海里的位置，機艙受損。事件未造成人員傷亡。
此外，美國中央司令部否認伊朗聲稱其防空系統周五（20日）在波斯灣上空擊中一架美軍F-16戰機的說法，並表示：「所有部署在中東的美軍戰機均安全無虞，且行蹤都已獲得確認。」伊朗軍方則透過伊朗伊斯蘭共和國通訊社（IRNA）宣稱，該戰機飛行員進行了緊急迫降。
根據伊朗塔斯尼姆通訊社（Tasnim）報導，伊朗副外交部長加里巴巴迪（Kazem Gharibabadi）表示，德黑蘭認為美國的經濟封鎖是「戰爭行為」，並將採取「一切必要措施」打破封鎖。
加里巴巴迪指出，伊朗核計畫相關談判尚未開始，濃縮鈾材料「在任何情況下」都不會離開伊朗。
伊朗國營電視台IRIB報導，伊朗軍方發言人阿克拉米尼亞（Mohammad Akraminia）表示，若美國再次發動侵略行動，伊朗將立即予以堅決回應。他並強調，華府必須接受伊朗提出的條件，才能結束戰爭。
另根據IRIB報導，伊朗海軍表示，一艘位於荷姆茲海峽以東的油輪在限制區域觸及海雷後起火，事發時該船的識別及導航系統均已關閉。
伊朗革命衛隊（IRGC）則宣稱，已在荷姆茲海峽上空擊落一架美軍MQ-9無人機，並在格什姆島（Qeshm Island）上空擊落一架MQ-1「掠奪者」無人機。不過，美國政府尚未證實這兩架無人機遭擊落。
一名未具名的伊朗軍方官員向國營媒體表示，伊朗部隊當晚對船隻及美軍軍機發動「最猛烈的行動之一」，並補充說，油輪不能指望美軍護送它們離開相關海域。
原油周五報每桶83.62美元，隨著供應情勢緩解，本月以來下跌14%，但仍高於2月戰爭爆發前約67美元的水準。
UKMTO周五將荷姆茲海峽的威脅等級評為「嚴重」，目前海峽航運量較戰前水準減少約65%。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump said on Saturday (the 21st) that he wants to reach a permanent agreement to prevent Iran from acquiring nuclear weapons, saying that even if "four, fifteen or twenty years from now we have an incompetent president," the deal should remain in force. At the same time, two tankers off the coast of Oman were attacked.

According to Investing.com, Trump told Fox News that Iran's leadership "might be more reasonable, but they are extremely, extremely difficult to deal with." He added that even if a deal were reached, Iran could violate its commitments the next day.
Trump also claimed that he has already removed Iran's leadership twice and is now facing a third set of leaders, describing the situation as an "ultimate regime change."

Meanwhile, the United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) said the two tankers were hit by "unidentified flying objects" as they were leaving the Strait of Hormuz. One vessel was struck on its stern in waters 11 nautical miles north of the Omani coastal city of Khasab, and the other suffered damage to its engine room 17 nautical miles east of the strait. No injuries were reported.

In addition, U.S. Central Command denied Iran's claim that its air‑defense system shot down a U.S. F‑16 over the Persian Gulf on Friday (the 20th), stating, "All U.S. aircraft deployed in the Middle East are safe and their locations have been confirmed." The Iranian military, via the Islamic Republic News Agency (IRNA), said the pilot performed an emergency landing.
Iranian Deputy Foreign Minister Kazem Gharibabadi told Tasnim News Agency that Tehran considers the U.S. economic blockade a "act of war" and will take "all necessary measures" to break it.
Gharibabadi added that negotiations on Iran's nuclear program have not yet begun and that enriched uranium material will not leave Iran "under any circumstances."

Iran state TV IRIB reported that military spokesman Mohammad Akraminia said Iran would respond decisively if the United States launched another act of aggression, emphasizing that Washington must accept Iran's conditions to end the war.

IRIB also reported that the Iranian navy said a tanker east of the Strait of Hormuz caught fire after striking a sea mine in a restricted area, noting that the vessel's identification and navigation systems were shut down at the time of the incident.

The Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) claimed it shot down a U.S. MQ‑9 drone over the Strait of Hormuz and an MQ‑1 "Reaper" drone over Qeshm Island, though the U.S. government has not confirmed either shoot‑down.

An unnamed Iranian military official told state media that Iranian forces carried out "one of the most intense actions" against the ships and U.S. aircraft that night, adding that tankers could not expect U.S. escort out of the area.
Crude oil futures were at $83.62 per barrel on Friday, down 14% since the start of the month as supply concerns eased, but still above the roughly $67 level before the war erupted in February.
UKMTO rated the threat level in the Strait of Hormuz as "severe" on Friday, noting that current traffic through the strait is about 65% lower than pre‑war levels.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元走軟 日元、瑞郎強升 比特幣跌破6萬美元
items.title_en: <New York Forex> Dollar Weakens, Yen and Franc Rally, Bitcoin Falls Below $60,000
paras: 美元指數週五 (20 日) 小幅走低，終止連八個交易日上漲。市場對人工智慧 (AI) 產業的疑慮持續衝擊全球股市，資金轉進美國公債避險，帶動殖利率下滑，推升日元與瑞郎。不過，聯準會 (Fed) 官員持續釋出鷹派訊號，加上市場降低對風險貨幣的持有意願，限制美元跌幅。
美股尾盤時段，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣表現的美元指數下跌 0.07%，至 103.87，仍接近前一交易日觸及、2025 年 4 月以來的最高水準。
美元這波漲勢在 11 月 10 日加速，當時美國通膨數據高於預期，強化市場對聯準會進一步緊縮政策的押注。聯準會理事沃勒 (Christopher Waller) 也表示，應考慮在 12 月升息 2 碼。
Bannockburn Capital Markets 首席市場策略師 Marc Chandler 表示：「我認為美元的上漲動能已經停滯……但現在就認定美元已經見頂，還有點太早。」
美債避險買盤湧現 日元、瑞郎受惠
AI 相關疑慮持續壓抑全球股市，Anthropic (ANT-US) 週四創紀錄的上市案，也未能有效提振投資人信心。資金週五轉向公債避險，推動美債殖利率下滑，提高日元與瑞郎等低利率貨幣的相對吸引力。
Chandler 表示：「當美國利率下降時，低收益貨幣就顯得更具吸引力。」
美元兌瑞郎下跌 0.51%，報 1 美元可兌換 0.8396 瑞郎；美元兌日元下跌 0.73%，報 1 美元可兌換 158.50 日元，顯示瑞郎與日元雙雙兌美元升值。日元匯價仍接近日本當局今年 7 月進場干預、支撐日元時的水準。
除了美債殖利率下降，日本通膨數據也提供日元支撐。日本 10 月核心消費者物價指數 (CPI) 年增率加速至 2.2%，連續第二個月高於日本銀行的 2% 目標，顯示物價壓力擴散，強化日銀近期升息的理由。
Chandler 指出：「日元今天走強，受到美國利率下降，以及日本 10 月 CPI 表現強勁的帶動。」
凱投宏觀分析師認為，日元近期的疲弱走勢不太可能持續。
隨著日本長期通膨預期已接近目標，殖利率進一步上升將主要反映實質利率提高，加上該機構預期美債殖利率將下降，兩項因素應有利日元。
聯準會維持鷹派 川普再批利率過高
儘管美元回落，策略師認為，聯準會偏向升息的政策前景仍將提供支撐。
ING 全球市場主管 Chris Turner 表示，雖然目前支持股市再度大幅修正的理由有限，但「聯準會沒有理由在短期內放棄鷹派論調」。
他指出，下週公布的美國個人消費支出物價指數 (PCE)，可能進一步確認聯準會有必要採取行動。
聯準會理事庫克 (Lisa Cook) 週五也支持進一步升息，表示目前政策利率不足以因應通膨，並稱她對通膨水準「深感憂慮」。
美國總統川普則在週五記者會上表示，目前利率過高，並批評聯準會具有「政治性」。
其他主要貨幣方面，歐元兌美元小跌至 1.0963 美元；英鎊兌美元下跌至 1.3080 美元，仍徘徊在一年低點附近。澳元與紐元分別下跌 0.71% 及 0.36%，反映風險貨幣持續承壓。
加密貨幣也遭拋售浪潮襲擊。
隨著投資人擔憂 AI 相關資產估值過高，賣壓擴及其他風險資產，比特幣週五跌破 6 萬美元，為 7 月以來首見，報導更新時下跌約 6%，至 57,939 美元。

paras_en: The U.S. dollar index slipped slightly on Friday (the 20th), ending an eight‑day winning streak. Ongoing concerns about the artificial‑intelligence (AI) sector continued to weigh on global equities, prompting a shift into U.S. Treasury safe‑haven assets, which pushed yields lower and boosted the yen and Swiss franc. However, hawkish signals from Federal Reserve officials and reduced appetite for risk currencies limited the dollar's decline.

In the late‑session of U.S. equities, the dollar index, which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, fell 0.07% to 103.87, still near the highest level reached on the previous trading day, the peak since April 2025.

The dollar's recent rally accelerated on November 10 when U.S. inflation data came in hotter than expected, strengthening market bets on further Fed tightening. Fed Governor Christopher Waller also said a 25‑basis‑point rate hike in December should be considered.
Marc Chandler, chief market strategist at Bannockburn Capital Markets, said: “I think the dollar’s upward momentum has stalled… but it’s still a bit early to declare that the dollar has peaked.”
U.S. Treasury safe‑haven buying lifts yen and franc

AI‑related worries kept global equities under pressure, and even Anthropic’s (ANT‑US) record‑setting IPO on Thursday failed to lift investor confidence. On Friday, funds moved into Treasury safe‑haven assets, driving U.S. bond yields lower and raising the relative appeal of low‑yield currencies such as the yen and Swiss franc.
Chandler added: “When U.S. rates fall, low‑yield currencies become more attractive.”

The dollar fell 0.51% against the franc to $1 = 0.8396 CHF, and 0.73% against the yen to $1 = 158.50 JPY, indicating that both currencies appreciated versus the greenback. The yen rate remains close to the level at which Japanese authorities intervened in July to support the currency.

In addition to falling U.S. yields, Japanese inflation data also supported the yen. Japan’s October core consumer‑price index (CPI) annualised rate accelerated to 2.2%, the second consecutive month above the Bank of Japan’s 2% target, showing broader price pressure and bolstering the case for a recent BOJ rate hike.
Chandler noted: “The yen’s strength today is driven by falling U.S. rates and the strong October CPI reading in Japan.”
Macro analyst at KGI believes the yen’s recent weakness is unlikely to persist.

With Japan’s long‑term inflation expectations now near target, any further rise in yields will mainly reflect higher real rates, and the institution expects U.S. Treasury yields to fall – two factors that should benefit the yen.
Fed Maintains Hawkish Stance as Trump Again Criticises High Rates
Even though the dollar retreated, strategists say the Fed’s bias toward rate hikes will continue to provide support.

Chris Turner, head of global markets at ING, said that while there are limited reasons at present to justify another sharp equity correction, “the Fed has no reason to abandon its hawkish tone in the short term.”
He added that next week’s U.S. personal consumption expenditures (PCE) price index could further confirm the Fed’s need to act.
Fed Governor Lisa Cook also backed further tightening on Friday, saying current policy rates are insufficient to curb inflation and expressing “deep concern” about inflation levels.
Former President Donald Trump told reporters on Friday that rates are currently too high and criticized the Fed as being “political.”

Among other major currencies, the euro slipped to $1.0963, the pound fell to $1.3080, hovering near a one‑year low, while the Australian and New Zealand dollars dropped 0.71% and 0.36% respectively, reflecting continued pressure on risk assets.
Cryptocurrencies also came under selling pressure.

As investors worried that AI‑related assets were overvalued, selling spread to other risk assets and Bitcoin fell below $60,000 on Friday – the first time since July – dropping about 6% to $57,939 at the time of the update.

items.title: 〈台幣〉央行強力穩盤 收32.936元升值0.6分
items.title_en: New Taiwan Dollar: Central Bank Strongly Stabilizes, Closes at 32.936, Up 0.6 Points
paras: 台股加權指數今(20)日再度破底，市場出現強烈的去槓桿壓力，單日跌點達2393點，創史上第三大跌點，一周來已跌掉7641點，周跌幅17.5%，台北匯市見到中央銀行全力穩盤調節，新台幣終場收在32.936元，升值0.6分，與股市脫鉤，台北外匯經紀公司成交值則縮至21.02億美元。
新台幣今日以32.96元、貶值1.8分開出後，盤中一度轉升值，午盤過後又見貶值壓力湧出，收盤半小時又轉升，顯示來回拋補的拉鋸力道激烈，但成交量萎縮，全日高低價差1.2角。
觀察主要亞幣，日元強彈超過0.4%，人民幣升0.3%，星元升0.15%上下，泰銖升約0.1%，新台幣收升0.02%，而韓元貶值約0.1%。
法人分析，聯準會官員有提到AI的蓬勃發展正在加劇經濟過熱風險，企業投資達到空前規模但經濟產能未必承受得住，使聯準會將不得不應對短期影響，而這些影響目前看來是推升通膨，在此鷹派聲浪下，暫難見到帶動外資回頭的訊號，使匯市偏弱整理。
paras_en: The Taiwan weighted index broke its low again today (20th), with the market under strong deleveraging pressure. It fell 2,393 points in a single day, the third‑largest point drop in history, and has lost 7,641 points over the past week, a weekly decline of 17.5%. In the Taipei foreign‑exchange market the central bank stepped in forcefully to stabilize the currency; the New Taiwan dollar closed at 32.936, appreciating 0.6 points and decoupling from the equity market. Turnover at Taipei FX brokers shrank to US$2.102 billion.

The New Taiwan dollar opened at 32.96, down 1.8 points, then rose briefly during the session. After the midday break, depreciation pressure resurfaced, but in the half‑hour before close it turned upward again, showing a fierce tug‑of‑war between buying and selling. However, trading volume contracted and the daily high‑low range was only 0.12 yuan.

Among the major Asian currencies, the Japanese yen surged more than 0.4%, the Chinese renminbi rose 0.3%, the Singapore dollar gained about 0.15%, the Thai baht edged up roughly 0.1%, the New Taiwan dollar finished up 0.02%, while the South Korean won depreciated about 0.1%.

Analysts note that Federal Reserve officials have warned that the rapid growth of AI is heightening the risk of an overheated economy. Corporate investment is reaching unprecedented levels, but productive capacity may not keep pace, forcing the Fed to address short‑term impacts that currently appear to be feeding inflation. Amid this hawkish sentiment, there is little sign of foreign capital returning, leaving the FX market in a weak, consolidating stance.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元漲勢暫歇 Anthropic上市提振風險偏好 日元走貶
items.title_en: <New York Forex> Dollar Gains Pause as Anthropic IPO Boosts Risk Appetite, Yen Depreciates
paras: 美元週四(19日)兌多數主要貨幣回落，近期漲勢暫歇。人工智慧(AI)公司Anthropic即將掛牌，提振市場風險偏好，削弱美元買盤。不過，聯準會(Fed)官員的鷹派談話與最新會議紀錄，仍使進一步升息的預期支撐美元，美元指數維持在約19個月高點附近。
美股尾盤時段，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.2%，報103.65；歐元兌美元上漲0.2%，報1.1002美元。
美元指數本週觸及2025年4月2日以來最高水準。當時，美國總統川普宣布大規模關稅措施，引發美國資產賣壓。
美元這波漲勢始於11月10日，當時美國通膨數據高於預期，促使投資人提高對聯準會緊縮政策的押注。聯準會理事華勒(Christopher Waller)呼籲採取更積極措施對抗通膨，而10月27日至28日的會議紀錄也顯示，決策官員愈來愈擔心，可能需要進一步緊縮政策。
加拿大豐業銀行首席外匯策略師奧斯本(Shaun Osborne)表示：「美元這段時間已經漲了不少，我認為目前匯價已反映許多利多。」
他指出，美元多頭若要在短期內推升匯價，需要更強的信心或更多利多消息。他並將美元部分回落，歸因於Anthropic首次公開發行(IPO)前，市場風險情緒改善。
Anthropic的IPO定價高於原先行銷區間，帶動週四那斯達克期貨上漲，也提高市場對其上市表現的期待，重新提振AI類股投資情緒。
巴克萊分析師則認為，財政刺激與強勁的AI相關資本支出，反映美國經濟具有韌性，也意味經濟產出高於潛在水準的幅度可能擴大，利率將在更長時間內維持高檔，這些因素均有利美元。
儘管近期科技股遭到拋售，美元仍獲得資金流入支撐。德意志銀行追蹤逾100檔在美國境外註冊的指數股票型基金(ETF)發現，外國投資人過去兩週大舉逢低買進美股，買進力道為今年最強，顯示流向美股的資金也是支撐美元的重要因素。
隨著風險偏好回升、避險需求降溫，日元兌美元走貶。美元兌日元上漲0.4%，報159.905日元兌1美元，中止連續四個交易日下跌。
分析師指出，若AI相關資產再度遭到拋售，避險買盤與資金匯回日本可能支撐日元，但日元兌其他貨幣的升勢，可能比兌美元更為明顯。
澳幣兌美元則大致持平。澳洲10月就業人數連續第二個月減少，失業率升至五年高點，強化市場對當地利率可能已觸頂的看法。
三菱日聯金融集團(MUFG)資深外匯分析師 Lee Hardman表示，市場大幅上調對聯準會升息的預期，正對大宗商品價格及相關貨幣形成壓力。

paras_en: The dollar fell against most major currencies on Thursday (the 19th), pausing its recent rally. The upcoming IPO of AI company Anthropic lifted market risk appetite and weakened dollar buying pressure. However, hawkish comments from Federal Reserve officials and the latest meeting minutes still support expectations of further rate hikes, keeping the dollar index near a 19‑month high.
In the late‑day US equity session, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the dollar against six major currencies, slipped 0.2% to 103.65, while the euro rose 0.2% to $1.1002.
The dollar index this week reached its highest level since April 2, 2025, when President Trump announced large‑scale tariff measures that triggered selling pressure on US assets.

The current dollar rally began on November 10, when US inflation data came in above expectations, prompting investors to increase bets on tighter Fed policy. Fed Governor Christopher Waller called for more aggressive action against inflation, and the minutes from the Oct. 27‑28 meeting showed policymakers growing increasingly concerned that further tightening may be needed.

Shaun Osborne, chief FX strategist at Canada’s BMO Capital Markets, said: “The dollar has already risen a lot in recent weeks, and I think the current exchange rates already reflect much of the upside.”

He added that for dollar bulls to push rates higher in the short term they would need stronger conviction or more positive news, and he attributed the dollar’s partial pullback to improved market risk sentiment ahead of Anthropic’s IPO.
Anthropic’s IPO was priced above its initial marketing range, lifting Nasdaq futures on Thursday and raising expectations for its market debut, which revived sentiment toward AI‑related stocks.

Barclays analysts argue that fiscal stimulus and robust AI‑related capital spending show the US economy is resilient, suggesting output may be running above potential for longer, keeping rates high – a backdrop that benefits the dollar.

Despite recent tech‑stock sell‑offs, the dollar continued to attract inflows. Deutsche Bank, tracking over 100 offshore‑registered ETFs, found foreign investors bought US equities in large volumes over the past two weeks – the strongest buying this year – indicating that capital flowing into US stocks also underpins the dollar.
With risk appetite recovering and hedging demand easing, the yen weakened against the dollar. The USD/JPY rose 0.4% to 159.905 yen per dollar, ending a four‑day decline.

Analysts note that if AI‑related assets face another sell‑off, safe‑haven buying and capital returning to Japan could support the yen, but the yen’s gains against other currencies may be more pronounced than against the dollar.

The Australian dollar was roughly flat versus the US dollar. October employment in Australia fell for the second consecutive month, pushing the unemployment rate to a five‑year high and reinforcing market views that local rates may have peaked.
Lee Hardman, senior FX analyst at MUFG, said the market’s sharp upgrade of expectations for Fed rate hikes is putting pressure on commodity prices and related currencies.

UBS, considering still‑elevated Australian inflation and worsening labour and housing conditions, moved its forecast for the Reserve Bank of Australia’s first rate cut from November next year to August and increased the expected number of cuts from two to three.

The pound rose 0.1% to $1.3162, but the GBP/EUR slipped from a 20‑month peak. Investors remain bullish on UK rate prospects while staying cautious about the potential drag on the euro from several major European elections slated for 2027.
In crypto, improved risk appetite lifted Bitcoin 2.5% to $63,870, pulling it out of the four‑month low of $62,026 hit last Sunday.

items.title: 〈台幣〉央行積極調節匯市波動 貶轉升收32.942元
items.title_en: NTD: Central Bank Actively Adjusts FX Market Volatility, Depreciation Turns to Appreciation, Closing at 32.942
paras: 台北股匯市遭逢雙殺壓力，除了金管會自明(20)日起再祭出五大穩定股市措施，包括重啟「有條件禁空令」，中央銀行也積極調節匯市波動，終場收在32.942元，升值0.5分，台北外匯經紀公司成交值則縮至22.63億美元。
新台幣今日以32.96元、貶值1.3分開出後，最低一度貶至33.04元，但觸及33元心理大關後貶勢並未擴大，收盤前15分鐘更轉升，收在32.942元，高低價差1.2角。
由於成交值較昨日見收斂，法人解讀資金拋補大鬥法已稍微緩解，不過，尚未見到台股的止跌訊號，匯市能否就此守住無形的33元防線，仍受到市場密切關注。
觀察主要亞幣，日元貶值約0.3%，新台幣收升0.02%，星元和人民幣微幅波動不到0.05%，韓元升0.1%左右，泰銖升0.2%，而美元指數小跌近0.1%。
法人指出，聯準會內部鷹派釋出12月應考慮升息2碼的訊息，令市場風險意識持續提高，同時，後黃仁勳時代的AI投資焦慮高漲，AI估值調整壓力持續消化中。
值得留意的是，獨立新創AI Anthropic將在台灣時間今日晚上掛牌，掛牌行情成另一個左右市場信心的重要焦點。
paras_en: Taipei stock and forex markets faced double‑kill pressure. Starting today (20th), the Financial Supervisory Commission rolled out five major measures to stabilise the stock market, including re‑instating the "conditional short‑selling ban". The central bank also actively adjusted FX market volatility, ending the session at 32.942, up 0.5 points, while the turnover of Taipei foreign‑exchange brokerage firms shrank to $2.263 billion.

The New Taiwan dollar opened today at 32.96, down 1.3 points, fell to a low of 33.04, but after hitting the psychological 33‑level the decline did not deepen. In the last 15 minutes before close it turned higher, finishing at 32.942, with a daily range of 1.2 jiao.

Because turnover narrowed compared with yesterday, institutional investors interpret that the large‑scale fund‑outflow battle has eased somewhat, yet no clear bottoming signal has appeared for the Taiwan stock market. Whether the FX market can now hold the intangible 33‑level barrier remains under close market scrutiny.

Looking at major Asian currencies, the Japanese yen weakened about 0.3%, the New Taiwan dollar rose 0.02%, the Singapore dollar and the Chinese yuan fluctuated less than 0.05%, the Korean won rose roughly 0.1%, the Thai baht rose 0.2%, while the US dollar index slipped nearly 0.1%.

Institutions note that hawkish voices inside the Fed have signalled that a 20‑basis‑point rate hike should be considered in December, raising market risk awareness. At the same time, AI‑investment anxiety is soaring in the post‑Jensen Huang era, and pressure from AI valuation adjustments continues to be digested.
Worth noting is that the independent AI startup Anthropic will list tonight Taiwan time, and its debut price will become another key focus influencing market confidence.

◆GBP/USD

週三英國公布10月消費者物價指數(CPI)較上年同期漲3.6%，創一年新高，但核心與服務業價格通貨膨脹率兩項基礎指標年率分別持穩於2.8%及3.7%，不及預期將上升，降低英國央行(BOE)下月升息的概率，打擊英鎊兌美元自1.3212高點下滑。隨著BOE總裁貝利稱，英國勞動力市場似乎不再趨鬆，但存在一定程度的閒置，擴大英鎊兌美元跌幅至1.3132低點。預估今日英鎊兌美元阻力於1.3150-70，支撐於1.3060-80。

U.S. October retail sales showed modest growth and import price increases exceeded expectations, strengthening market bets that the Federal Reserve will tighten monetary policy further in December. Meanwhile, tech giant Nvidia shed recent volatility and posted better‑than‑expected sales forecasts, boosting equities on Wednesday and keeping the dollar near a 19‑month high. Japan’s October trade deficit narrowed sharply to ¥476.5 billion, with imports and exports up 21.6% and 20.5% year‑on‑year respectively, both hitting record monthly levels. Strong global investment continues to support demand for semiconductor‑related products, driving export growth for the 14th consecutive month. BOJ Governor Kazuo Ueda told parliament that, given the still‑accommodative financial environment, rate hikes should continue, emphasizing the need to keep core inflation near the 2% target and to adjust monetary easing appropriately as the economy, prices and financial conditions evolve, providing support for the yen and pulling USD/JPY down to a low of 159.11.

Subsequent U.S. October data showed that building permits – a leading indicator of future construction activity – fell 7.4% to an annualized 1.295 million units, while housing starts rose 9.9% to an annualized 1.309 million, beating forecasts. The NAHB survey reported the October existing‑home‑sales‑to‑inventory index slipped 4.7% to 63, the lowest since the series began in 2001. Fed governors Waller and Bahl expressed that more aggressive action is needed to combat inflation, and the Fed’s October meeting minutes revealed that policymakers unanimously agreed to keep rates unchanged for now, though some members suggested a 50‑basis‑point hike, lifting USD/JPY to a high of 159.65. The dollar‑yen pair is expected to face resistance at 159.50‑70 and support at 158.60‑80 today.
EUR/USD

Australia’s Q3 wage‑price index rose 1.1% yesterday, the biggest gain since the end of 2023, indicating a still‑tight labour market. The data are lagging and have not yet reflected the impact of the fifth rate hike this month. In the interest‑rate swap market, the probability of the Reserve Bank of New Zealand raising rates by 25 bps is seen at 80%, with a cumulative 85 bps increase priced in for the end of next year. Conversely, the odds that Australia’s rates have peaked are estimated at 73%, with about 24 bps of cuts priced in for the end of next year. These dynamics have pushed the Australian dollar toward a ten‑month low and the New Zealand dollar to its lowest since March 2020, weighing on the euro‑dollar pair, which is capped by a ceiling at 1.0999.

Four sources disclosed that ECB policymakers plan to discuss raising the minimum reserve requirement for euro‑area banks to 2% next week. The ECB’s financial‑stability report noted that market pressure should prompt France to take self‑disciplinary measures on its high‑debt issue, signalling no rush to intervene in member‑state debt problems, which has pushed EUR/USD down to a low of 1.0952. The pair is expected to face resistance at 1.0975‑95 and support at 1.0900‑20 today.
GBP/USD

The UK released its October CPI on Wednesday, up 3.6% year‑on‑year – a one‑year high – while core inflation and services price inflation held steady at 2.8% and 3.7% respectively, below expectations of a rise. This reduces the probability of a Bank of England rate hike next month and has pulled sterling down from a high of 1.3212. BOE Governor Andrew Bailey said the labour market appears less slack but still has some idle capacity, widening the pound’s fall to a low of 1.3132. The pound‑dollar pair is expected to face resistance at 1.3150‑70 and support at 1.3060‑80 today.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元走強 Fed鷹派官員支持採取積極行動
items.title_en: New York FX Market: Dollar Strengthens as Hawkish Fed Official Backs Aggressive Action
paras: 美元週三(18日)週三走強，升至19個月來新高，受到美國聯準會(Fed)官員華勒(Christopher Waller)的鷹派談話，以及近期經濟數據影響，市場對下個月升息的預期更加確立。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.2%，報103.78，創2025年4月以來最高。
聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)拒絕提供未來政策指引，使投資人更加依賴經濟數據，以及其他決策官員的談話，來判斷聯準會下一步動向。
華勒接受CNBC訪問時表示，如果央行希望降低通膨，就必須採取更「積極的行動」，包括在12月會議升息半個百分點，或是在會後聲明中引導市場預期，為進一步升息做好準備。
上週公布的通膨數據高於預期，使市場完全反映聯準會12月升息25個基點的預期，同時認為升息50個基點仍存在小幅可能性。芝商所(CME Group)FedWatch工具顯示，週二公布數據指出，美國10月零售銷售溫和成長，進一步強化市場對下個月升息的預期。
Monex USA駐華盛頓交易部門資深總監Juan Perez表示，「目前聯準會似乎非常堅定的準備升息，甚至可能採取更激進的升息方式。」
Perez指出，「這正是目前支撐美元走強的市場信念。」
不過，策略師也警告，美元若要延續升勢，可能需要新的利多催化因素。
Pepperstone研究策略師Dilin Wu表示，「若要推動美元從目前水準進一步顯著走高，市場可能需要開始反映2027年更為激進的升息路徑。」
CME FedWatch工具顯示，交易員預期，12個月後聯準會基準利率將較目前上升約75個基點，來到4.50%至4.75%的區間。投資人也將密切關注紐約聯準銀行總裁威廉斯(John Williams)、聯準會理事巴爾(Michael Barr)，以及明尼阿波利斯聯準銀行總裁卡什卡里(Neel Kashkari)稍晚的談話，以判斷央行下一步政策方向。
美元漲勢已將其他主要貨幣推向數個月來低點。
歐元兌美元下跌0.2%，至1.09735美元，盤中一度觸及2025年4月以來最低。

paras_en: The dollar strengthened on Wednesday (the 18th), reaching a 19‑month high, boosted by hawkish comments from Fed official Christopher Waller and recent economic data, solidifying market expectations of a rate hike next month.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, rose 0.2% to 103.78, the highest since April 2025.
Fed Chair Kevin Warsh refused to provide forward guidance, causing investors to rely more on economic data and remarks from other policymakers to gauge the Fed’s next move.

In a CNBC interview, Waller said that if the central bank wants to bring inflation down, it must take more “aggressive action,” including a 0.5‑percentage‑point rate hike at the December meeting or guiding market expectations in the post‑meeting statement to prepare for further hikes.

Last week’s inflation data came in hotter than expected, leading the market to fully price in a 25‑basis‑point Fed hike in December while still seeing a small chance of a 50‑basis‑point increase. CME Group’s FedWatch tool showed that Tuesday’s data, which reported modest growth in U.S. retail sales for October, further reinforced expectations of a rate hike next month.
Juan Perez, senior director of Monex USA’s Washington trading desk, said, “The Fed now appears very resolute in preparing to raise rates, and may even adopt a more aggressive tightening path.”
Perez added, “That is the market belief currently underpinning the dollar’s strength.”
However, strategists warned that for the dollar to keep climbing, a new bullish catalyst may be needed.

Dilin Wu, a strategist at Pepperstone, said, “To push the dollar significantly higher from current levels, the market may need to start pricing in a more aggressive rate‑hike trajectory through 2027.”

CME’s FedWatch tool shows traders expect the Fed’s benchmark rate to be about 75 basis points higher in 12 months, landing in the 4.50%‑4.75% range. Investors will also watch later remarks from New York Fed President John Williams, Fed Governor Michael Barr, and Minneapolis Fed President Neel Kashkari to gauge the central bank’s next policy step.
The dollar’s rally has pushed other major currencies toward multi‑month lows.
The euro fell 0.2% against the dollar to $1.09735, briefly touching its lowest level since April 2025.
The pound slipped 0.3% to $1.3165, a one‑month low. Data showed Britain’s core inflation for October held steady month‑over‑month, easing market expectations of an imminent BoE rate hike.

The yen was roughly flat at ¥159.29 per dollar. Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda reiterated that monetary policy still needs further tightening. The yen remains near the level the Japanese government intervened at in July this year to support the weak currency.

Markets also focused on the three‑way summit scheduled for Thursday in Shenzhen, attended by U.S. President Donald Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping, and Russian President Vladimir Putin. The talks could cover Russia’s war in Ukraine, the Iran conflict, as well as trade, AI and nuclear issues.

paras: 新台幣今(18)日在外資持續賣股匯出的壓力下，一度又貶破33元整數大關，收盤前半小時緩和貶勢，終場收在32.947元，貶值9.7分，台北外匯經紀公司成交值仍處在歷史相對高的量能，為27.31億美元。
法人解讀，新台幣收在33元關卡內，是中央銀行的強力表態。
新台幣今日以32.83元、升值2分開出後，越走越低，最低見33.023元，高低價差達1.93角。
而主要亞幣中，韓元強彈超過0.4%，日元也升值近0.1%，人民幣處平盤狹幅震盪，星元貶約0.1%，新台幣收貶0.3%；美元指數彈升超過0.2%。
元大投顧指出，國際市場焦點集中在兩大消息，一為輝達創辦人黃仁勳離開輝達後，是否會令AI晶片訂單與展望受到干擾，所幸甫公布的財報優於預期。
其次為通膨與升息壓力，因聯準會官員持續偏鷹言，元大投顧認為12月升息機率逼近90%，使美10年期公債殖利率保持5%之上。
paras_en: The New Taiwan dollar today (18th) under continued pressure from foreign investors selling stocks and repatriating funds once again fell below the 33 NTD whole‑number mark; in the half hour before market close the depreciation eased, ending at 32.947 NTD, down 9.7 cents. Taipei foreign‑exchange brokerage firms’ transaction volume remained at a historically high relative level, at US$2.731 billion.
Institutional interpretation: the NT$ closing within the 33‑NTD threshold is a strong signal from the central bank.
The NT$ opened today at 32.83 NTD, up 2 cents, then kept falling, reaching a low of 33.023 NTD, with a high‑low spread of 0.193 NTD.

Among major Asian currencies, the Korean won rebounded more than 0.4%, the Japanese yen appreciated nearly 0.1%, the Chinese yuan hovered flat with narrow fluctuations, the Singapore dollar slipped about 0.1%, and the NT$ fell 0.3%; the US dollar index rose over 0.2%.

Yuanta Securities noted that international market focus is on two major news items: first, whether Nvidia founder Jensen Huang’s departure will disrupt AI chip orders and outlook, fortunately the just‑released earnings were better than expected.

Second, inflation and rate‑hike pressure: with Fed officials continuing hawkish rhetoric, Yuanta Securities believes the probability of a December rate hike is approaching 90%, keeping the US 10‑year Treasury yield above 5%.
